diff_summary: Formatted demo deletion guards preserving exact whole-file AST and SQL text.

verification.command: .venv/bin/python -c 'import ast,pathlib,subprocess; p="backend/app/demo_race_repository.py"; src=pathlib.Path(p).read_text(); tree=ast.parse(src); assert ast.dump(tree)==ast.dump(ast.parse(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:"+p],text=True))); f=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="validate_demo_race_delete"); subprocess.run([".venv/bin/ruff","check","--select","E501","--stdin-filename",p,"-"],input=ast.get_source_segment(src,f),text=True,check=True)'
